lexunit.name: cut.v
lexunit.definition: COD: divide into pieces with a knife or other sharp implement.

lexunit.name: carve.v
lexunit.definition: FN: cut into hard material, sometimes with a carving knife.

frame.name: Bungling
frame.definition:
An Agent performs an Action incorrectly. The affected Patient may be mentioned metonymically for the Action.
Ex: ["Agent" Mickey] BOTCHED ["Action" that swing]. Ex: ["Agent" Julia] BUNGLED ["Patient" the cake].

fe.name: Degree
fe.definition:
This FE identifies the Degree to which a bungling event occurs.
Ex: Mickey ["Degree" really] BOTCHED that swing.

fe.name: Depictive
fe.definition:
Depictive identifes a phrase describing a particpant in an action.
Ex: Mickey BOTCHED that swing ["Depict" without his cap].

fe.name: Manner
fe.definition:
This FE identifies the Manner in which theAgent bungles.
Ex: Mickey BOTCHED that swing ["Manner" deliberately].

fe.name: Means
fe.definition:
This FE identifies the Means by which an Agent bungles.
Ex: Mickey BOTCHED that swing ["Means" by leaning forward].

fe.name: Agent
fe.definition: The Agent performs an action incorrectly. Ex: ["Agent" Mickey] BOTCHED that swing.

fe.name: Patient
fe.definition: Patient is the entity affected by the Agent's bungling of an Action. Ex: Mickey FUMBLED ["Patient" the ball].

fe.name: Place
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Place where the bungling occurs.

fe.name: Instrument
fe.definition:
This FE identifies the Instrument with which an Agent bungles.
Ex: Mickey BOTCHED that swing ["Ins" with a heavy bat].

fe.name: Time
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Time when the bungling occurs.

fe.name: Action
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Action that the Agent performs incorrectly. Ex: Mickey BOTCHED ["Action" that swing].

fe.name: Area
fe.definition: The type of action that the Agent habitually bungles. Ex: The Austro-Hungarian Empire had a long history of ["Area" military] SCREW-UPS.

lexunit.name: bungler.n
lexunit.definition: FN: someone prone to making stupid mistakes.

lexunit.name: fiasco.n
lexunit.definition: COD: a ludicrous or humiliating failure.

lexunit.name: blow_it.v
lexunit.definition: FN: completely bungle (an opportunity)

lexunit.name: bungle.v
lexunit.definition: COD: carry out (a task) clumsily or incompetently.

lexunit.name: botch.v
lexunit.definition: COD: carry out (a task) badly or carelessly.

lexunit.name: ruin.v
lexunit.definition: FN: to screw something up irreparably.

lexunit.name: mess up.v
lexunit.definition: COD: mishandle a situation.

lexunit.name: fuck up.v
lexunit.definition: COD: do something badly or ineptly; damage or confuse someone emotionally.

lexunit.name: fuck-up_((event)).n
lexunit.definition: COD: a mess or muddle.

lexunit.name: screw-up event.n
lexunit.definition: COD: a situation that has been completely mismanaged or mishandled

lexunit.name: mess-up.n
lexunit.definition: FN: a minor mistake.

lexunit.name: fuck-up_((person)).n
lexunit.definition: COD: a person who has a tendency to make a mess of things.

lexunit.name: screw-up_person.n
lexunit.definition: FN: a person who habitually makes mistakes

lexunit.name: fumble.v
lexunit.definition: FN: the clumsy use of one's hands while doing something

lexunit.name: fumble.n
lexunit.definition: COD: an act of fumbling

lexunit.name: foozle.v
lexunit.definition: COD: bungle.

lexunit.name: screw up.v
lexunit.definition: COD: completely mismanage or mishandle a situation

lexunit.name: bungling.a
lexunit.definition: FN: prone to clumsily botching things

lexunit.name: bumbling.a
lexunit.definition: FN: generally acting in an incompetent manner.

lexunit.name: bumble.v
lexunit.definition: COD: act or speak in an awkward or confused manner.

lexunit.name: flounder.v
lexunit.definition: COD: stagger clumsily in mud or water; have trouble doing or understanding something.

lexunit.name: founder.v
lexunit.definition: FN: sink, fall

lexunit.name: stumble.v
lexunit.definition: FN: make a mistake or repeated mistakes

lexunit.name: bollix.v
lexunit.definition: FN: accidentally cause to be in an undesirable state.

lexunit.name: bollix up.v

lexunit.name: botch up.v
lexunit.definition: FN: carry out a task without getting the desired result.

lexunit.name: blow.v
lexunit.definition: FN: completely fail to achieve

lexunit.name: ball up.v
lexunit.definition: FN: fumble a course of actions

lexunit.name: flub.v
lexunit.definition: COD: botch or bungle.

lexunit.name: foul up.v
lexunit.definition: COD: make a mistake with or spoil something.

lexunit.name: fluff.v
lexunit.definition: COD: fail to accomplish (something) properly.

lexunit.name: louse up.v
lexunit.definition: COD: spoil something.

lexunit.name: muck up.v
lexunit.definition: COD: spoil something.

lexunit.name: muff.v
lexunit.definition: COD: handle clumsily; bungle.

frame.name: Dispersal
frame.definition: An Agent or a Cause disperses or scatters Individuals from the Source,a relatively confined space, to a the Goal_area, a broader space.

fe.name: Agent
fe.definition: The Agent disperses or scatters the Individuals.

fe.name: Individuals
fe.definition: The Individuals are scattered by the Agent.

fe.name: Source
fe.definition: Source is the relatively confined space from which an Agent scatters the Individuals.

fe.name: Goal_area
fe.definition: Goal_area identifies the broader space to which the Agent scatters the Individuals

fe.name: Cause
fe.definition: An event or force that causes that Individuals to disperse.

fe.name: Manner
fe.definition:
Any description of the dispersing event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). With agentive uses, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (eagerly, carefully).
Ex: He ["Manner" carefully] SCATTERED more mud around the rose bed

fe.name: Time
fe.definition: The Time when the Individuals are dispersed.

fe.name: Means
fe.definition: An intentional action performed by the Agent that accomplishes the dispersal.

fe.name: Result
fe.definition: A state of the Individuals that results from the dispersal.

fe.name: Path
fe.definition: The trajectory along which the Individuals move.

fe.name: Place
fe.definition: The Place where the dispersing event happens.

fe.name: Reason
fe.definition: A state of affairs that the Agent is responding to in dispersing the Individuals

fe.name: Distance
fe.definition:
The distance that the Individuals move from their original location, the Source.
Ex: Firing four shots into the air SCATTERED them ["Distance" only a short distance], but it was enough.

fe.name: Speed
fe.definition:
The rate of motion of the Individuals, usually in terms of how long it takes for them to leave the Source and end up in the Goal_area.
Ex: We DISPERSED the smoke ["Speed" as rapidly as possible].

lexunit.name: disperse.v
lexunit.definition: COD: go or distribute in different directions or over a wide area.

lexunit.name: dissolve.v
lexunit.definition: COD: (with reference to a solid) become or cause to become incorporated into a liquid so as to form a solution

lexunit.name: scatter.v
lexunit.definition: COD: throw in various random directions.

lexunit.name: dissolution.n
lexunit.definition: COD: the action or process of dissolving or being dissolved.

lexunit.name: dispersal.n
lexunit.definition: FN: the fact of distributing in different directions or over a wide area

lexunit.name: dispersion.n
lexunit.definition: COD: the action, process, or state of dispersing or being dispersed.

lexunit.name: distribute.v
lexunit.definition: COD: hand or share out to a number of recipients.

lexunit.name: distribution.n
lexunit.definition: FN: the fact of handing or sharing out to a number of recipients.

lexunit.name: spread.v
lexunit.definition: FN: distribute a mass or a number of individuals over a surface

lexunit.name: strew.v
lexunit.definition: COD: scatter untidily over a surface or area

lexunit.name: sprinkle.v
lexunit.definition: COD: scatter or pour (small drops or particles) over an object or surface.

lexunit.name: disseminate.v
lexunit.definition: COD: spread widely

frame.name: Cooking_creation
frame.definition:
This frame describes food and meal preparation. A Cook creates a Produced_food from (raw) Ingredients. The Heating_Instrument and/or the Container may also be specified.
["Cook" Caitlin] BAKED ["Food" some cookies] ["Ingredients" from the pre-packaged dough].

fe.name: Cook
fe.definition: The Cook prepares the Produced_food. Ex: ["Cook" Drew] COOKED dinner for his friends. Ex: ["Cook" Drew] BAKED an apple pie.

fe.name: Produced_food
fe.definition: The Produced_food is the result of a Cook's efforts. Ex: Drew PREPARED ["Food" dinner] for his friends. Ex: Drew BAKED ["Food" an apple pie] for dessert.

fe.name: Heating_Instrument
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Heating_Instrument with which the Cook prepares the Food. Ex: Drew PREPARED vegetable soup ["Heat_instr" in a crock pot].

fe.name: Container
fe.definition:
This FE identifes the Container that holds the food being produced. Ex: BAKE the quiche ["Container" in a pie tin].
Things that apply the heat directly are Heating_Instruments, e.g. _crock-pot_, _electric griddle_.

fe.name: Place
fe.definition:
This FE identifies the Place where the cooking creation occurs.
Ex: Drew PREPARED the soup ["Place" in the kitchen].

fe.name: Means
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Means by which the cooking creation is performed. Ex: Drew PREPARED the soup ["Means" by throwing some vegetables into a pot of water].

fe.name: Purpose
fe.definition:
This FE identifies the Purpose for which the cooking creation is performed.
Ex: Drew BAKED an apple pie ["Purp" to show Patty he was sorry].

fe.name: Recipient
fe.definition:
Recipient identifies the person for whom the food has been prepared.
Ex: Drew BAKED an apple pie ["Rec" for Patty.]

fe.name: Time
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Time when the cooking creation occurs. Ex: Drew BAKED an apple pie ["Time" at six int he morning].

fe.name: Degree
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Degree to which an event occurs.

fe.name: Manner
fe.definition:
This FE identifies the Manner in which the cooking creation performed.
Ex: Drew PREPARED dinner ["Manner" hastily].

fe.name: Ingredients
fe.definition: The Ingredients which are altered by The Cook alters Ingredients to create the Produced_food. Ex: Drew BAKED a pie ["Ingr" with apples, nuts, and raisins.]

lexunit.name: concoct.v
lexunit.definition: COD: make a dish or meal by combining ingredients

lexunit.name: cook up.v
lexunit.definition: FN: make something to eat

lexunit.name: whip_up.v
lexunit.definition: COD: make or prepare something, especially food, very quickly

lexunit.name: cook.v
lexunit.definition: COD: prepare food by mixing, combining, and heating the ingredients.

lexunit.name: prepare.v
lexunit.definition: COD: make food ready for cooking or eating

lexunit.name: make.v
lexunit.definition: FN: produce a meal or a component of a meal

lexunit.name: bake.v
lexunit.definition: COD: cook food by dry heat without direct exposure to a flame, typically in an oven

lexunit.name: put together.v
lexunit.definition: FN: make food by mixing ingredients; mix ingredients

frame.name: Seeking
frame.definition: A Cognizer_agent attempts to find some Sought_entity by examining some Ground. The success or failure of this activity (the Outcome) may be indicated. NB: This frame should be compared to the Scrutiny frame, in which the primary focus is on the Ground.

fe.name: Cognizer_agent
fe.definition: The person who attempts to find the Sought_entity. ["Cognizer_agent" John] LOOKED for his pencil.

fe.name: Ground
fe.definition: This is the entity to which the Cognizer pays attention. It is referred to as GROUND because it serves as the background or context for the Phenomenon. This FE can be expressed as an NP Object or as a PP Complement: Leslie EXAMINED ["Ground" the glass] for cracks. Kim SEARCHED ["Ground" in the woods] for mushrooms.

fe.name: Sought_entity
fe.definition: This is the entity that the Ground may contain. Typically, it is expressed as a_for_-PP. Leslie EXAMINED the glass ["Sought_entity" for cracks]. Kim SEARCHED in the woods ["Sought_entity" for mushrooms]. Some words in this frame allow alternate expressions of the Ground and the Sought_entity: We searched the yard for my contact lens. We searched for my contact lends in the yard.

fe.name: Manner
fe.definition: Manner of performing an action

fe.name: Means
fe.definition: An act of the Cognizer_agent that allows them to look for the Sought_entity. Ex: They FORAGED for clams ["Mns" by visiting the pools at low tide].

fe.name: Outcome
fe.definition: The failure or success of an attempt.

fe.name: Place
fe.definition:
A spatial setting larger than the Ground in which the Seeking event occurs.
Ex: ["Place" In Paris] police were HUNTING for suspects in two of the city's southerns suburbs today

fe.name: Time
fe.definition:
This FE identifies the time when the Seeking occurs.
Ex: The police were HUNTING for evidence in my house ["Time" yesterday]

fe.name: Purpose
fe.definition:
An action that the Cognizer intends to accomplish by performing the search.
Ex: Police were HUNTING for evidence in my house ["Purpose" to mislead their real suspect about the state of the investigation]

fe.name: Degree
fe.definition: This FE identifies the amount of effort put into an attempt.

lexunit.name: sniff.v
lexunit.definition: COD: discover something by covert investigation.

lexunit.name: listen.v
lexunit.definition: COD: make an effort to hear something.

lexunit.name: watch.v
lexunit.definition: FN: keep on the lookout for (something or someone)

lexunit.name: look.v
lexunit.definition: COD: (look for) attempt to find.

lexunit.name: grope.v
lexunit.definition: COD: feel about or search blindly or uncertainly with the hands.

lexunit.name: fumble.v
lexunit.definition: FN: seek with clumsy, uncertain movements of the hands

lexunit.name: feel.v
lexunit.definition: COD: perceive, examine, or search by touch. NB: Only searching relevant in this frame.

lexunit.name: forage.v
lexunit.definition: COD: search widely for food or provisions

lexunit.name: hunt.v
lexunit.definition: COD: search diligently for.

lexunit.name: nose.v
lexunit.definition: COD: look around or pry into something.

lexunit.name: probe.v
lexunit.definition: COD: physically explore or examine.

lexunit.name: rummage.v
lexunit.definition: COD: search unsystematically and untidily for something

lexunit.name: scour.v
lexunit.definition: COD: subject to a thorough search

lexunit.name: ransack.v
lexunit.definition: COD: thoroughly search.

lexunit.name: pan.v
lexunit.definition: COD: wash gravel in a pan to separate out (gold).

lexunit.name: pat down.v
lexunit.definition: FN: use one's hands to search someone else's body for contraband

lexunit.name: frisk.v
lexunit.definition: COD: pass the hands over (someone) in a search for hidden weapons or drugs.

lexunit.name: seek.v
lexunit.definition: COD: attempt to find.

lexunit.name: search.v
lexunit.definition: COD: examine thoroughly in order to find something.

lexunit.name: palpate.v
lexunit.definition: COD: examine (a part of the body) by touch, especially for medical purposes.

lexunit.name: examine.v
lexunit.definition: COD: inspect closely to determine the nature or condition of; investigate thoroughly

lexunit.name: comb.v
lexunit.definition: COD: search carefully and systematically.

frame.name: Excreting
frame.definition:
An Excreter excretes Excreta.
Ex: ["Excreter" Principal Skinner] BURPED ["Goal" on me]. Ex: ["Excreter" Lenny and Karl] PEE ["Frequency" three times a day].

fe.name: Excreta
fe.definition: The Excreta is the waste expelled by the body. Ex: ["Excreter" Dr. Nick] VOMITED ["Excreta" puke] ["Path" across the table].

fe.name: Excreter
fe.definition: The Excreter is the agent who excretes the Excreta.

fe.name: Source
fe.definition: The Source is the starting point of the Excreta's motion.

fe.name: Path
fe.definition: Path identifies the trajectory of the Excreta.

fe.name: Goal
fe.definition: The Goal is where the Excreta finishes its motion.

fe.name: Manner
fe.definition: The Manner in which the Excreter engages in excretion.

fe.name: Means
fe.definition: The Means by which the Excreter engages in excretion.

fe.name: Place
fe.definition: This FE identifieis the Place where the excretion occurs.

fe.name: Time
fe.definition: When the Excreter engages in excretion.

fe.name: Purpose
fe.definition: The Purpose is the motivation behind the Excreter's act. Ex: ["Excreter" Rod Flanders] VOMITED ["Purpose" to get out of choir practice].

fe.name: Frequency
fe.definition: TheFrequencyis the number of times per time period that the Excreter is engaged in exctretion.

fe.name: Degree
fe.definition:
The Degree to which all of the Excreta are removed from the body.
Ex: Patients need to VOID their bladder ["Degree" completely] before surgery

frame.name: Chemical-sense_description
frame.definition:
This frame covers the descriptions of tastes and smells, and has one main frame element, Source. The frame element Sensory_attribute occurs mainly with the words taste, flavour, and smell.
Ex: The almonds had a BITTER ["Sensory_attribute" taste]. Ex: ["Source" The almonds] _are_ BITTER.

fe.name: Perceptual_source
fe.definition: Perceptual_source is used for the entity that is being described. A recipe can stand in for a Perceptual_source which is a kind of food.

fe.name: Degree
fe.definition:
This FE identifies the Degree to which a chemical sense is described.
Ex: The almonds are ["Degr" extremely] bitter.

fe.name: Sensory_attribute
fe.definition:
Sensory_attribute is used for words that describe the perception itself.
Ex: The almonds had a BITTER ["Sensory_attribute" taste]. Ex: The coffee had a PUNGENT ["Sensory_attribute" smell].

lexunit.definition: COD: have a strong or unpleasant odour.

frame.name: Breathing
frame.definition: An Agent causes Air to move in a direction, usually specifying either in or out of the body.

fe.name: Agent
fe.definition: The Agent's breathing causes the motion of the Air. Agent is generally the External Argument. Ex: ["Agent" Lee] BREATHED the hot desert air.

fe.name: Air
fe.definition: Air is the substance that the Agent causes to move. Ex: Lee BREATHED ["Air" the hot desert air].

fe.name: Goal
fe.definition: This FE identifies the point at which theAir ends up as a result of the motion. Ex: Lee BREATHED ["Goal" into Ann's mouth].

fe.name: Manner
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Manner in which an Agent breathes. Ex: Lee BREATHED ["Manr" deeply.]

fe.name: Means
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Means of breathing. Ex: Lee BREATHES ["Means" with a respirator].

fe.name: Source
fe.definition: Source identifies the starting point of the Air. Ex: Lee EXHALED ["Source" from the bottom of his lungs].

fe.name: Path
fe.definition:
This FE identifies thePath of the motion through locations after leaving the Source and before reaching the Goal.
Ex: Lee BREATHED ["Path" through his mouth].

fe.name: Degree
fe.definition:
This FE identifies the degree to which an Agent is breathing.
Ex: Lee was BREATHING ["Degree" too hard].

fe.name: Depictive
fe.definition: Depictive identifies a phrase describing a participant in a breathing event. Ex: Lee was BREATHING calmly, ["Depict" naked on the floor].

fe.name: Place
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Place where the breathing occurs. Ex: Lee BREATHED with difficulty ["Place" on the track].

fe.name: Duration
fe.definition: This FE idenitfies the Duration of time that an Agent breathes. Ex: Lee BREATHED deeply ["Duration" for thirty seconds.]

fe.name: Distance
fe.definition:
The distance that the Air travels.
Ex: He EXHALED the poison gas from the tooth ["Distance" a full three feet].

fe.name: Instrument
fe.definition:
An entity that allows the Agent to breathe, either a natural part (the lungs, say) or a device (like a respirator).
Ex: He has to BREATHE ["Ins" with an oxygen mask].

fe.name: Time
fe.definition:
The time at which breathing occurs.
Ex: All I know is that he was still BREATHING ["Time" at 2AM].

fe.name: Internal_cause
fe.definition:
This FE designates internal events/states that cause the Agent to exhibit the specified type of breathing. Further, the internal state of the Agent is perceivable to others because of the breathing event.
Ex: He GASPED ["int" in horror] .

fe.name: External_cause
fe.definition:
This FE denotes an event or state external to the Agent that causes them exhibit the specified manner of breathing but not as a conscious response to the External_cause.
Ex: Isabel GASPED ["External_cause" at the strength of his grip].

fe.name: Circumstances
fe.definition:
Circumstances are expressions indicating prevailing physical conditions or states of affairs concurrent to the breathing event.
Ex: They RESPIRE ["cir" at lower levels of light, temperature, and tissue moisture than bryophytes].

fe.name: Purpose
fe.definition:
An action that the Agent intends to accomplish by breathing in the specified manner.
Ex: Blanche RESPIRED steadily ["pur" to allow the tension to subside].

lexunit.name: breathe.v
lexunit.definition: COD: take air into the lungs and then expel it as a regular physiological process.

lexunit.name: inhale.v
lexunit.definition: COD: breathe in.

lexunit.name: breath.n
lexunit.definition: COD: an inhalation or exhalation of air from the lungs.

lexunit.name: exhale.v
lexunit.definition: COD: breathe out.

lexunit.name: gasp.v
lexunit.definition: COD: catch one's breath with an open mouth, owing to pain or astonishment. strain to obtain (air) by gasping.

lexunit.name: sigh.n
lexunit.definition: COD: a long, deep, audible exhalation expressing sadness, tiredness, relief, etc.

lexunit.name: exhalation.n
lexunit.definition: FN: air expelled by breathing out.

lexunit.name: exhalation_act.n
lexunit.definition: FN: the act of breathing out.

lexunit.name: inhalation.n
lexunit.definition: FN: the act of breathing in.

lexunit.name: inhalation_breath.n
lexunit.definition: FN: air which is taken in.

lexunit.name: huff.v
lexunit.definition: COD: blow out noisily.

lexunit.name: puff.v
lexunit.definition: COD: breathe in repeated short gasps

lexunit.name: sigh.v
lexunit.definition: COD: emit a sigh

lexunit.name: blow.v
lexunit.definition: COD: expel air through pursed lips.

lexunit.name: expire.v
lexunit.definition: COD: exhale (air) from the lung.

lexunit.name: inspire.v
lexunit.definition: FN: inhale

lexunit.name: insufflate.v
lexunit.definition: COD: blow or breathe (vapour, a powdered medicine, etc.) into or through a body cavity.

lexunit.name: pant.v
lexunit.definition: COD: breathe with short, quick breaths, typically from exertion or excitement.

lexunit.name: respire.v
lexunit.definition: COD: breathe

lexunit.name: suspire.v
lexunit.definition: COD: breathe

frame.name: Escaping
frame.definition:
A Self-moving Escapee departs from an Undesirable_location.
Ex: ["Escapee" Benjamin] ESCAPED ["Undesirable_location" from Germany].

fe.name: Escapee
fe.definition: The Escapee manages to leave the Undesirable_location. Ex: ["Escapee" Benjamin] ESCAPED from Germany.

fe.name: Goal
fe.definition: Goal identifies any expression which tells where the Escapee ends up, or would end up, as a result of the motion. Ex: Benjamin ESCAPED ["Goal" to the United States].

fe.name: Means
fe.definition:
["Means" ] covers any act performed by the Escapee brings about the escape.
Ex: Benjamin ESCAPED from Germany ["Means" by bribing the border guards].

fe.name: Manner
fe.definition:
Manner is used for any expression which describes a property of motion which is not directly related to the trajectory of motion, including descriptions of steadiness, grace, means of motion, etc.
Ex: Benjamin ESCAPED from Germany ["Manner" with difficulty].

fe.name: Undesirable_location
fe.definition:
The ["" Undesirable_location] is where the Escapee begins.
Ex: Benjamin ESCAPED ["Undesirable_location" from Germany].

fe.name: Speed
fe.definition:
Speed idenitifies the rate at which the escaping occurs.
Ex: Benjmain ["Speed" speedily] ESCAPED from Germany.

fe.name: Vehicle
fe.definition:
Vehicle identifies the means of conveyance by which the Escapee leaves the Undesirable_location.
Ex: Benjamin ESCAPED ["Vehicle" in a lorrie].

fe.name: Time
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Time when the escaping occurs.

fe.name: Purpose
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Purpose for which the escaping takes place. Ex: Benjamin ESCAPED from Germany ["Purpose" to rsave his life].

fe.name: Place
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Place where the Escaping occurs.

fe.name: Depictive
fe.definition: Depictive identifies a word or phrase describing a participant of an action. Ex: Benjamin ESCAPED ["Depictive" unscathed].

fe.name: Path
fe.definition:
Path describes the trajectory of motion of the Escapee.
Ex: Benjmain ESCAPED from Germany ["Path" along the southern border].

fe.name: Degree
fe.definition:
This FE identifies the (abstract) nearness of the Escapee to being caught in the Undesirable_location.
Ex: Benjamin's ["Degr" narrow] ESCAPE from Germany left him fearful.

fe.name: Distance
fe.definition:
The distance along a path away from the Undesirable_location that the Escapee travels.
Ex: She ESCAPED ["dis" a few feet] away, then looked back at him coldly.

lexunit.name: escape.v
lexunit.definition: COD: break free from confinement or control

lexunit.name: evacuate.v
lexunit.definition: COD: leave (a dangerous place).

lexunit.name: get out.v
lexunit.definition: FN: manage to escape confinement.

lexunit.name: bust_out.v
lexunit.definition: FN: escape forcefully from.

lexunit.name: fly the coop.v
lexunit.definition: FN: escape (usually initially unnoticed) from a long-standing situation.

lexunit.name: scarper.v
lexunit.definition: FN: flee, run away

lexunit.name: get_free.v
lexunit.definition: FN: escape a place of restriction or confinement

lexunit.name: get_loose.v
lexunit.definition: FN: escape a state of being bound or tethered

frame.name: Avoiding
frame.definition: An Agent avoids an Undesirable_situation under certain Circumstances. That situation may be an activity (e.g. going to school), or an entity (perhaps) metonymic for such an activity or situation (e.g. the curb). The situation may be undesirable from the Agent's point of view (e.g. _evade_), to someone else (e.g. _forbear_), or from the point of view of an external morality (e.g. _abstain_).

fe.name: Agent
fe.definition: The Agent avoids an Undesirable_situation. Ex: ["Agent" Mike] AVOIDED his supervisor at all costs.

fe.name: Place
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Place where the avoiding occurs.

fe.name: Time
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Time when the avoiding occurs.

fe.name: Purpose
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Purpose avoiding occurs.

fe.name: Undesirable_situation
fe.definition: This FE identifies the situation that the Agent avoids. Ex: Mike AVOIDED ["Und_sit" his supervisor] at all costs.

fe.name: Means
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Means by which avoiding occurs.

fe.name: Manner
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Manner in which avoiding occurs.

fe.name: Circumstances
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Circumstances under which the Undesirable_situation is avoided. Ex: Mike AVOIDED his supervisor ["Circumstances" at all costs].

fe.name: Degree
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Degree to which avoiding occurs.

fe.name: Reason
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Reason for which avoiding occurs.

lexunit.name: avoid.v
lexunit.definition: COD: keep away or refrain from

lexunit.name: evade.v
lexunit.definition: COD: escape or avoid, especially by guile or trickery

lexunit.name: dodge.v
lexunit.definition: COD: cunningly avoid doing or paying.

lexunit.name: duck.v
lexunit.definition: COD: evade (an unwelcome duty).

lexunit.name: escape.v
lexunit.definition: COD: succeed in eluding (something dangerous or undesirable)

lexunit.name: shirk.v
lexunit.definition: COD: avoid or neglect (a duty or responsibility).

lexunit.name: shun.v
lexunit.definition: COD: persistently avoid, ignore, or reject.

lexunit.name: sidestep.v
lexunit.definition: COD: avoid dealing with or discussing

lexunit.name: skirt.v
lexunit.definition: COD: avoid dealing with.

lexunit.name: avoidance.n
lexunit.definition: FN: the fact or practice of keeping away or refraining from

lexunit.name: sidestep.n
lexunit.definition: COD: an instance of sidestepping

lexunit.name: evasion.n
lexunit.definition: COD: the action or an instance of evading.

lexunit.name: eschew.v
lexunit.definition: COD: abstain from.

lexunit.name: keep_away.v
lexunit.definition: FN: stay away or refrain from

lexunit.name: forgo.v
lexunit.definition: COD: go without (something desirable).

lexunit.name: shrink_from.v
lexunit.definition: COD: be averse to or unwilling to do (something).

lexunit.name: desist.v
lexunit.definition: COD: cease; abstain.

lexunit.name: stay away.v
lexunit.definition: FN: keep away or refrain from

frame.name: Evading
frame.definition: An Evader moves under its own power to thereby avoid Capture or contact with a Pursuer, also generally moving under its own power. This frame characterizes a more specific event than Avoiding in that both the Evader and the Pursuer are moving entities. In addition, this frame differs from Escaping by requiring a Pursuer and being neutral about the prior captivity of the Evader.

fe.name: Area
fe.definition:
This FE is used for phrases that describe a generalArea in which motion occurs when it is understood to be irregular and not to consist of a single linear path. Locative setting adjuncts of motion expressions may also be assigned this frame element.
Ex: Smithers fled and EVADED them ["Area" all over the ship].

fe.name: Path
fe.definition:
Pathis used for any description of a trajectory of the motion of the Evader, including directional phrases.
Ex: Smithers FLED ["Path" northward].
Ex: Smithers EVADED the police ["Path" through the empty field].

fe.name: Evader
fe.definition:
The Evader moves under its own power to Capture or contact with the Pursuer. Normally the Evader frame element is expressed as an external argument.
Ex: ["Evader" The mouse] ELUDED the cats for only a few minutes.

fe.name: Mode_of_transportation
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Mode_of_transportation that the Evader uses to move. It can either bea part of the Evader's own body or a vehicle. Ex: Smithers GOT AWAY from us ["Mode_of_transportation" on foot] . Ex: Smithers GOT AWAY from us ["Mode_of_transportation" on bike] .

fe.name: Means
fe.definition:
This FE identifies the Means by which the Evader bringd about the evasion.
Ex: Smithers EVADED the police ["Mns" by ducking behind the dumpster].

fe.name: Pursuer
fe.definition:
The Pursuer is going after the Evader unless they act.
Ex: The mouse ELUDED ["Pursuer" the cats] for only a few minutes.

fe.name: Degree
fe.definition:
This FE is used for any expression that describes the Degree to which the Evader avoids Capture or contact with the Pursuer.
Ex: The mouse ["Degree" barely] ELUDED the cats.

fe.name: Manner
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Manner in which the evading occurs. It is used for any expression that does not relate directly to the trajectory of motion, including speed, steadiness, and grace. Ex: Smithers EVADED the police ["Manr" gracefully].

fe.name: Purpose
fe.definition:
This FE identifies the Purpose for which the Evading is done.
Ex: Smithers EVADED the police ["Purp" to prevent being captured].

fe.name: Reason
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Reason for which the Evading is. done. Ex: Smithers FLED ["Reason" because he feared capture].

fe.name: Circumstances
fe.definition:
This FE identifies the Circumstances under which the Evader evades the Pursuer, or avoids Capture.
Ex: Smithers EVADED the police ["Circumstances" at all costs].

fe.name: Time
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Time at which the Evading occurs. Ex: Smithers GOT AWAY ["Time" at the stroke of midnight].

fe.name: Depictive
fe.definition:
Depictive is used to identify the state of any of the participants in the evading event.
Ex: Smithers EVADED the police ["Dep" barefoot].

fe.name: Speed
fe.definition: This FE marks the Speed at which the Evader evades the Pursuer. Ex: Smithers GOT AWAY from the police ["Speed" at lightning speed].

fe.name: Capture
fe.definition:
An actual or hypothetical event in which the Pursuer takes physical control of the Evader.
Ex: Rýmirez-Sýnchez , tried in absentia , had EVADED ["Capture" capture] since the murders in Paris on June 27 , 1975

lexunit.name: evade.v
lexunit.definition: COD: escape or avoid, especially by guile or trickery

lexunit.name: evasion.n
lexunit.definition: COD: the action or an instance of evading.

lexunit.name: evasive.a
lexunit.definition: COD: directed towards avoidance or escape

lexunit.name: elude.v
lexunit.definition: COD: evade or escape from, typically in a skilful or cunning way.

lexunit.name: elusive.a
lexunit.definition: COD: difficult to find, catch, or achieve.

lexunit.name: give the slip.v
lexunit.definition: COD: escape or evade from someone

lexunit.name: flee.v
lexunit.definition: FN: run away while being pursued

lexunit.name: get away.v
lexunit.definition: COD: escape

frame.name: Cause_to_move_in_place
frame.definition: An Agent causes a Theme to move with respect to a certain Fixed_location, generally with a certain Periodicity, without undergoing unbounded translational motion or significant alteration of configuration/shape. Ex: ["Agent" Paul] SHOOK ["Theme" the remote control] ["Manner" frantically].

fe.name: Theme
fe.definition: Theme identifies the object involved in motion.

fe.name: Place
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Place where the event occurs.

fe.name: Duration
fe.definition: The amount of time for which a state holds or a process is ongoing.

fe.name: Reason
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Reason for which an event occurs.

fe.name: Time
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Time when the event occurs.

fe.name: Manner
fe.definition: Manner of performing an action

fe.name: Means
fe.definition: The Means is the way in which the motion in place is instigated.

fe.name: Degree
fe.definition: Degree to which event occurs

fe.name: Periodicity
fe.definition: The number of times the Theme returns to a state in a given duration. Ex: It TURNS ["Per" at 1000 rpms].

fe.name: Fixed_location
fe.definition: The point or set of points that define the limits of motion for the Theme. For spinning motions, it is the axis, for vibrating it is a boundary, for swinging it is a point. Ex: She TWIRLED ["Fix_loc" around him] several times. Ex: Balls SPIN ["Fix_loc" on their axes ]. Ex: The window VIBRATED ["Fix_loc" in the frame]. Ex: He SWUNG ["Fix_loc" by a single handhold].

fe.name: Agent
fe.definition: The Agent performs the intentional act.

fe.name: Instrument
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Instrument with which an intentional act is performed.

fe.name: Purpose
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Purpose for which an intentional act is performed.

fe.name: Angle
fe.definition: Angle identifies the amount that the Theme turns. Ex: SPIN the dial ["Ang" a quarter turn].

fe.name: Locus
fe.definition: The Agent's manipulation of an Theme may be further specified as being localized to some part of the Theme, a Locus. This FE is usually expressed as a PP Complement. Ex: Pat SQUEEZED Jo ["Locus" by the hand].

fe.name: Bodypart_of_agent
fe.definition: This FE identifies the part of the Agent's body being used to manipulate the Theme. Ex: Kim TWIRLED the glass ["Bodypart_of_agent" in his fingers].

fe.name: Cause
fe.definition: Cause identifies the non-agentive force that causes the motion in place. Ex: ["Cause" The wind] VIBRATED the string.

fe.name: Direction
fe.definition: This frame element is used for all path-like expressions, that express the Direction of the swinging, vibrating or rotating.

fe.name: Result
fe.definition: This FE identifies the Result of an event.

lexunit.name: twirl.v
lexunit.definition: COD: spin something quickly and lightly round.

lexunit.name: spin.v
lexunit.definition: COD: cause to turn round quickly

lexunit.name: vibrate.v
lexunit.definition: COD: cause to move with small movements rapidly to and fro.

lexunit.name: shake.v
lexunit.definition: FN: cause to tremble or vibrate or move something forcefully up and down or back and forth.

lexunit.name: swing.v
lexunit.definition: COD: move or cause to move back and forth or from side to side while or as if suspended

lexunit.name: seesaw.v
lexunit.definition: COD: change rapidly and repeatedly from one state or position to another and back again.

lexunit.name: turn.v
lexunit.definition: COD: move or cause to move in a circular direction wholly or partly around an axis.

lexunit.name: rotate.v
lexunit.definition: COD: cause to move in a circle round an axis.

lexunit.name: squeeze.v
lexunit.definition: COD: firmly press from opposite or all sides, typically with the fingers.

lexunit.name: swirl.v
lexunit.definition: FN: cause to move in a circular or spiral form

frame.name: Food
frame.definition:
This frame contains words referring to items of food.
Ex: Specialities include deep fried shredded beef , duck , prawn dishes and ["Descriptor" hand-made] NOODLES

fe.name: Descriptor
fe.definition: This FE indicates a characteristic or description of the food. Ex: She drinks ["Desc" low-fat] MILK

fe.name: Type
fe.definition: This FE identifies a particular Type of the food item. Ex: ["Type" cooking] APPLE Ex: ["Type" Granny Smith] APPLE.

fe.name: Constituent_parts
fe.definition:
A part of the Food.
Ex: You'd be surprised, but it was hard to eat a BANANA ["Constituent_parts" with such a thick peel].

lexunit.name: pea.n

lexunit.name: beef.n

lexunit.name: lobster.n

lexunit.name: milk.n

lexunit.name: cheese.n

lexunit.name: egg.n

lexunit.name: butter.n

lexunit.name: nut.n

lexunit.name: almond.n

lexunit.name: peanut.n

lexunit.name: pasta.n

lexunit.name: spice.n

lexunit.name: basil.n

lexunit.name: cereal.n

lexunit.name: sweet.n

lexunit.name: chocolate.n

lexunit.name: sweetener.n

lexunit.name: sugar.n

lexunit.name: honey.n

lexunit.name: fat.n

lexunit.name: vinegar.n
